name: The Insight Seeker

name: The Flow Master
description: You thrive when systems just work—smooth, scalable, and efficient, with friction removed.

description: You make sure everything checks out, valuing trusted data, confidence, and dependable outcomes.

name: The Experimenter
description: You push boundaries and explore possibilities, embracing new approaches before they're proven.
aiPromptContext: Values exploration and trying new things. Prioritizes innovation and creative problem-solving.
